description_original: AT&T GoPhone Microsoft Lumia 635 No-Contract Cell Phone: Stay in touch with your loved ones and remain entertained with the Microsoft Lumia 635, which allows you to connect to social media, check your e-mail, download apps and more, whether you're at home or on the go. The 4.5" touch screen is small enough to maintain portability, but large enough for clear viewing of videos, movies and TV shows.
